readmeHtml:
chele.bi

Personal blog and portfolio of Ege Vusal Chelebi (@woosal1337).

A dark, editorial personal site — writing, projects, and a reading shelf — built with Next.js 14 (App Router), MDX, Tailwind CSS, and Biome, deployed on Vercel.

Highlights

  • Editorial dark theme: Geist Sans for reading, Geist Mono for code, hairline borders, one motion curve.
  • MDX blog with a left-rail table of contents, callouts, and per-post chrome.
  • Post banners generated from the title — a deterministic contour mark (lib/contour.ts), no manual cover images.
  • Liquid-glass circular controls and frosted-glass tags.
  • A single contour identity mark drives the logo and favicons.

Stack

  • Next.js 14 (App Router), React 18, TypeScript
  • MDX posts colocated under app/(website)/blog/(post)/[slug]/page.mdx
  • Tailwind CSS with a token layer in app/globals.css (dark, editorial)
  • Reusable design-system primitives in components/ds/, domain blocks in components/blocks/
  • Biome for linting and formatting

Local setup

bun install
bun dev

Requires Node >= 20 and Bun. No environment variables required.

Commands

  • bun dev — dev server
  • bun run build — production build
  • bun run check — Biome lint and format with auto-fix

Credits

The live ASCII surfaces in components/blocks/ascii/ — donut, flow, plasma, tunnel — are ported from cobanov/soft-club-ui (MIT) and retuned monochrome against this site's tokens. The table-of-contents marker geometry follows ncdai's LineNav.

License

Code is MIT. Blog content and images are all rights reserved. See LICENSE.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A highly stylized personal blog and portfolio built with Next.js 14, MDX, and Tailwind CSS.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository contains the source code for a dark, editorial-themed personal blog and portfolio website. Built using the Next.js 14 App Router, it utilizes MDX for content authoring, allowing technical writing to be seamlessly integrated with interactive React components. The site features a sophisticated design system including liquid-glass controls, frosted-glass tags, and live monochrome ASCII surface animations. Instead of relying on manual cover images, the blog uses a deterministic contour generation script to dynamically create unique post banners based on titles. It prioritizes a sharp reading experience utilizing Geist Sans and Geist Mono typography.
keyFeatures: MDX content authoring: Allows writing blog posts in markdown while colocating complex React components and frontmatter directly inside the Next.js App Router.
Deterministic contour banners: Generates unique post cover imagery algorithmically from post titles using a custom contour script, eliminating manual image creation.
Editorial dark theme: Implements a highly polished aesthetic using Tailwind CSS with hairline borders, Geist typography, and a single precise motion curve.
Live ASCII animations: Integrates ported and retuned monochrome ASCII surface animations (like donuts and plasma flows) directly into the UI blocks.
Advanced navigation: Features a dedicated left-rail table of contents for deep articles with specialized marker geometry for tracking reading progress.
Modern build tooling: Utilizes Bun for extremely fast dependency installation and local development, alongside Biome for strict linting and formatting.
